name: Fabiola Prilipco
original_name: ファビオラ・プリリッコ
source:
""H-- How dare you students call me Pri-chan!? I am a proud DEVA police investigator-- Prilipco's the name!"

- Origin: Delta Empire
- Birthday: June 8
- Height: 163cm
- Three Size: B84(C)/W62/H91
- Likes: Exams
- Dislikes: Anything violates order
- Will/Gem: "Karma Flux Formula" Panta Rhei Aventurine

An agent affiliated with Delta Border Patrol, commonly known as DEVA.
She came into her current position with a goal to protect the Empire, after her experience with the "Stone Eater" petrifying her hometown.
She does have a problem with every Academia members calling her Pri-chan or other overfamiliarizing names.

[Translated from [url=http://cabbage-soft.com/character/]Official Website[/url]]
